description: Window [2→9]: strategy-positioning through quality-release. Idea exists; skip idea-sourcing. Build and ship. Stop at quality-release with no growth or idea-pmf phase markers.

turns.text: Activate cycle:have-idea-to-ship. I have a formed idea with rough positioning. Go straight to shipped product; skip idea-sourcing.
Continue: analysis-discovery — technical discovery and current-state comparison.
Continue: specification — spec with acceptance criteria and schema contracts.
Continue: design-ux — UX flows and component designs.
Continue: architecture — API contract, system ADR, infrastructure selection.
Continue: ai-ml — design AI route or confirm no AI component.
Continue: build — implement. This is the first turn where build evidence is allowed.
Continue: quality-release — run tests, pass reliability gate. This is the window stop. Do NOT proceed past the window stop.
